tex_content.label: SMPheat
tex_content.html:
For a compact connected manifold with boundary, a Dirichlet heat solution $h$ with $h(\cdot ,0)\ge 0$ remains nonnegative; if it is positive at one initial point, it is positive on the interior for positive times.

Proposition
[Strong maximum principle for curvature tensors]
